carpet_red.note: Dark red woven fabric with fine diagonal ribbing; reads as plain red carpet / heavy upholstery. | tile ~0.5 x 0.5 m (use ~1 m for a coarser carpet look)

carpet_office_grey.note: Light grey commercial carpet tiles, patchwork of loop-pile squares; back offices and staff corridors. 512 px, no roughness map (use roughness ~0.95). | tile ~2.0 x 2.0 m

carpet_paisley.note: Ornate tan/ochre paisley woven fabric with red accents; patterned hotel/casino carpet or upholstery. No roughness map (use ~0.9). | tile ~1.2 x 1.2 m as carpet, ~0.6 m as upholstery

fabric_damask.note: Black fabric with copper-gold damask ornaments; wall covering, curtains or upholstery. 512 px. Ornament threads are meant to be metallic (not encoded here). | tile ~0.6 x 0.6 m

felt_green.note: Casino-green table cloth / baize with subtle woven mottling (green recolour of a denim scan). | tile ~0.5 x 0.5 m

leather_brown.note: Smooth mid-brown leather with fine grain. 512 px, no roughness map (use ~0.45). | tile ~0.4 x 0.4 m

wood_veneer_dark.note: Dark walnut-brown wood veneer, fine straight grain running along U (horizontal). Wall panelling, desks, bar fronts. | tile ~1.0 x 1.0 m

wood_veneer_mahogany.note: Warm red-brown mahogany veneer with wavy grain along U (horizontal). No normal map (surface is flat/lacquered). | tile ~1.2 x 1.2 m

parquet_dark.note: Dark red-brown strip parquet, glossy finish (low roughness), strips running along U. | tile ~1.0 x 1.0 m

parquet_herringbone.note: Dark brown herringbone parquet with visible grain, satin finish. | tile ~1.2 x 1.2 m

wood_floor_planks.note: Medium-brown rustic floor planks with knots, semi-gloss; NON-SQUARE 2:1 texture (1024x512), planks run along U. | tile ~2.0 x 1.0 m

plaster_beige.note: Plain beige painted interior wall, very subtle roller texture. | tile ~2.0 x 2.0 m

concrete_floor_worn.note: Dark worn concrete floor with scuffed remains of ochre paint; back-of-house, loading area, plant rooms. | tile ~2.0 x 2.0 m

concrete_light.note: Light grey board-formed concrete with panel seams; staff corridor walls or sealed floor. | tile ~2.4 x 2.4 m

marble_black.note: Polished black marble with white-grey veining (very low roughness, mirror-like). No normal map (flat polished surface). | tile ~1.5 x 1.5 m

marble_tiles_white.note: Polished white-lilac marble in a triangular/hexagonal tile layout with thin joints. | tile ~1.2 x 1.2 m

marble_tiles_beige.note: Honed beige limestone/marble slabs of mixed rectangular sizes. | tile ~2.0 x 2.0 m

stone_tiles_checker.note: Checkerboard of light and dark honed stone tiles (4 x 4 tiles per repeat), slightly worn. | tile ~1.2 x 1.2 m

tiles_white_small.note: Small glossy white square ceramic tiles (10 x 10 per repeat) with grey grout; washrooms, kitchen, staff areas. | tile ~1.0 x 1.0 m

terrazzo_tiles.note: Grey-black speckled terrazzo floor tiles (4 x 4 per repeat) with thin joints, polished; corridors and service areas. | tile ~1.6 x 1.6 m

metal_brushed_steel.note: Brushed stainless steel, brushing along U (horizontal). Set metalness = 1. | tile ~0.5 x 0.5 m

metal_gold.note: Polished gold / brass with faint tarnish spots and micro-scratches. Set metalness = 1. | tile ~0.8 x 0.8 m

brick_red.note: Red clay brick wall in running bond with grey mortar, slightly weathered. | tile ~0.7 x 0.7 m

ceiling_tile.note: One suspended acoustic ceiling panel (speckled white mineral fibre) including its T-bar frame; repeats into a grid. Colour only, NON-SQUARE 1:2 texture (512x1024). | tile ~0.6 x 1.2 m

concrete_yard_stained.note: Poured outdoor concrete slab, grey-beige with dark oil/water stains, hairline cracks and expansion joints. Yards, loading areas, garage floors. | tile ~2.0 x 2.0 m

asphalt_cracked.note: Weathered grey road asphalt with long cracks and patched seams; streets and car parks. | tile ~3.0 x 3.0 m

plaster_grey_dirty.note: Rough grey exterior render with dirt streaks and small blemishes; facades of plain commercial buildings. | tile ~1.0 x 1.0 m (use 2-3 m on large facades)

concrete_wall_panels.note: Smooth precast concrete wall with horizontal formwork seams and faint stains; boundary walls, car park structures. | tile ~2.0 x 2.0 m

metal_shutter_painted.note: Painted steel roller shutter: horizontal slats, worn grey paint with scratches. Roller doors, garage shutters. | tile ~2.0 x 2.0 m, slats along U

metal_corrugated.note: Galvanised corrugated steel sheet, ribs running along V (vertical), light grime. Gates, fences, sheds, cladding. | tile ~2.7 x 2.7 m

pavers_concrete.note: Grey interlocking concrete pavers (bone/wave shape) as used on Central European pavements. | tile ~1.8 x 1.8 m

metal_rusty.note: Painted sheet metal with heavy orange rust patches; skips, old bins, weathered steel parts. | tile ~1.0 x 1.0 m

models.note: Low, wide armless lounge chair, wooden legs, purple fabric with gold damask pattern. 0.83 w x 0.57 d m, ~10k triangles. CC-BY 4.0 (Wayfair / Eric Chadwick).
Same lounge chair with plain orange (mango) velvet-like fabric. 0.83 w x 0.57 d m, ~40k triangles (heavier; prefer chair_damask when placing many). CC0.
Curved navy-blue velvet lounge sofa on thin metal legs. 2.19 w x 1.02 d m, ~4k triangles. CC-BY 4.0 (Wayfair / Eric Chadwick).

Leafy house plant in a terracotta pot (leaves use alpha cutout, double-sided). 0.70 x 0.66 m footprint, ~68k triangles. CC-BY 4.0 (Darmstadt Graphics Group / Eric Chadwick; original plant by Rico Cilliers, CC0).

Small table lamp, dark drum shade on a glass base with iridescent coating. 0.30 m diameter, ~19k triangles. Glass uses transmission (extra render pass in three.js). No light source included. CC-BY 4.0 (Wayfair / Eric Chadwick).

Art-nouveau style floor lamp: curved bronze stem with a flower-shaped glass shade (decorative, not modern). 1.13 x 0.72 m footprint, ~6k triangles. Embedded lights removed; shade uses transmission. CC-BY 4.0 (DGG).
Small glass vase with flowers, table decoration. 0.22 x 0.14 m footprint, ~10k triangles. Glass uses transmission. CC0 (Eric Chadwick, Rico Cilliers).
Full black plastic rubbish bag, tied at the top. 0.53 x 0.46 m footprint, ~4.5k triangles, origin at the base. Textures WebP 1k. CC0 (Poly Haven).

Grey street-side electrical cabinet (cable distribution box) with a small warning label (English text) and a concrete plinth. 0.52 x 0.43 m footprint, ~4.4k triangles. Textures WebP 1k. CC0 (Poly Haven).
